description: This file provides an implementation of filesystem operations for Windows using the Win32 API, including functions for opening files with UTF-8 paths, creating directories, retrieving file status, and reading symbolic links, all with Unicode support.

methods.name: int fs_win32_openUTF8(const char * path,int oflag,int pmode)
methods.description: Opens a file given a UTF-8 encoded path on Windows, converting to wide character.

methods.name: int fs_win32_mkdirUTF8(const char * path,mode_t mode)
methods.description: Creates a directory with a UTF-8 path, converting to wide character.

methods.name: int fs_win32_stati64UTF8(const char * path,struct fs_win32_stati64UTF8 * st)
methods.description: Retrieves file status information for a UTF-8 path, handling trailing slashes.

methods.name: int fs_win32_readlinkUTF8(const char * path,char * result,size_t rsz)
methods.description: Reads the target of a symbolic link given a UTF-8 path, handling Windows-specific APIs.

ctags.name: fs_win32_openUTF8
ctags.pattern: /^int fs_win32_openUTF8 (const char *path, int oflag, int pmode)$/
